# Pillar PEO Advisors

> Independent HR advisory firm for professional-services firms of 10–150 people, anywhere in the U.S., headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. Fixed-price HR audits from $2,500, HR projects, fractional HR, and clean transitions into or out of a PEO. PEO brokerage is free to the client, with provider commission disclosed.

Pillar works with managing partners and practice administrators at law, CPA, engineering and architecture, medical and dental, RIA and nonprofit firms. Every engagement is priced before the work starts, and covers every state your people work in. Pillar sells no software and places no insurance.

## Services

- HR Audit (the Load Report) — $2,500 / $4,000 / $6,000 by headcount band.
- HR Projects — $1,500–$7,500 fixed: handbook, FLSA review, I-9 and E-Verify, comp benchmarking, performance, manager training.
- Fractional HR — Advisor 8 hrs/mo $2,000, Partner 20 hrs/mo $3,750, Embedded 40 hrs/mo $6,000. Three-month minimum.
- Transitions — $3,000–$10,000 fixed: PEO exit, PEO switch, PEO implementation, HRIS migration, payroll switch.
- PEO brokerage — $0 to the client, provider commission disclosed.

Full price list: /pricing.md
